question:
Study the given graph and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. Consider the percentage of workers in three categories, Skilled, Semi-skilled and Un-skilled in four companies, A, B, C and D in the graph below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04d67c435bd01ddcd228365e25cb94e274e4fd58a694694fad5c702fae3ac7ab.png] 

If all the companies have same number of total workers, then the company _______ has the highest number of Un-skilled workers and the company ________ has the lowest number of Skilled workers.
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of Skilled, Semi-skilled, and Un-skilled workers in companies A, B, C, and D:

Company A: Skilled = 30%, Semi-skilled = 40%, Un-skilled = 30%

Company B: Skilled = 25%, Semi-skilled = 30%, Un-skilled = 45%

Company C: Skilled = 40%, Semi-skilled = 40%, Un-skilled = 20%
